title: Memo triage
description: Structured output of the Chancellor's triage (`triageMemos`, PS-03b), passed to Claude Code with --json-schema: one decision for each memo of the batch, and the drafts its new quests name (the quest-draft shape). The CLI holds each decision against kingdom.delegation: within it, the Steward applies it with no owner (an edit_quest that merges, a create_quest made open, a decide_memo that sets aside); beyond it, the memo goes to the owner with this advice (escalate_memo, a draft for a new quest) and into the digest.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not expressible here, checked by zod: one decision per memo; draft_ref names a draft of the reply; draft refs are unique; a draft has no parent_ref, depends_on_refs or party_role. Not checked by this schema because they need other files: the memos are the batch's and the merge's quest is a draft or open quest (otherwise the memo goes to the owner); the drafts' kinds, tags and secrets exist (screenDrafts).

action.description: merge: into an open quest (`quest`); new_quest: a quest of its own (`draft_ref`); shelve: set aside, nothing to do now or a duplicate already handled; owner: only the owner can decide.

quest.description: merge: the quest in status draft or open that takes it in.

draft_ref.description: new_quest: the draft of `drafts` that does the work; duplicate memos name the same draft.

addendum.description: merge: what the quest's description gains, in the owner's language. Of duplicate memos merged into one quest, one carries it.

ask.description: The matters of the owner the memo touches: a recorded decision changes, a data contract outside the quest changes, it spends more mana than its rank, it acts outside the machine, it touches protected paths. Empty when none.

note.description: Why, in a sentence or two, in the owner's language: the memo's outcome or the digest says it.

class_required.description: Required for tier = session; one of kinds[kind].classes_allowed.

party_role.description: contract: the plan quest that forms a party; part: one area of a party, emitted by the party lead. The Steward sets party_id and creates the merge quest.

contract.description: Path of the contract inside the territory; required for a part.

scope_paths.description: The files the quest changes, as globs relative to the territory root (`packages/domain/src/dispatch/**`). Within a territory the Steward never starts a quest whose scope meets the scope a quest holds (from its first run until it is archived, waiting for the owner's merge included), unless its plot is built on that quest's branch; a session-tier quest without a scope runs alone among working quests. Files the work changes outside the scope go into the `quest.submitted` line and the judge's prompt, never an automatic fail. Hot files every branch edits belong in territory.shared_paths, not here.

context.description: The most tokens the session holds in its context at once: its prompt, the files it reads, the conversation. Above kingdom.breakers.context_budget_tokens the job is split; without it, tokens stands in.

seal_required.description: Only when the owner's words say whether the result waits for the seal; left out, the quest takes its kind's seal_default.

question.description: The one follow-up question; the quest is created in draft with blocked.question.

decisions.addendum: Cũng in giờ của `quest list` theo múi giờ của vương quốc, như `quest show`.
decisions.note: Quest dọn CLI đang mở cùng vùng file.
Đổi tên một trường của kingdom.json là đổi hợp đồng dữ liệu.
Một sửa nhỏ trong README của store, chưa quest nào giữ vùng đó.
